title: Jawan bete ke laashe par ye Laila sonchti hogi
body:
Jawan bete ke laashe par ye Laila sonchti hogi
Mujhe is din se pehle he na kyon mauth aagayi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaha karti thi Laila kaise baithoongi main saaye mein
Mere Akbar ki mayyat jalti rethi par padi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuda jaane dile Sarwar ka aalam kya huva hoga
Ali Akbar ne jisdum aaqri angdaai li hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali Akbar ka laasha aap lejate toh hain laikin
Dare qaime pah moula ghamzada Laila khadi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaha karti thi aksar sonchkar yeh Fatema Sughra
Mere bhaiyya Ali Akbar ki shaadi ho gayi hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Nikaali hogi sheh ne jab sina Akbar ke seene se
Ali ne badhkar peshaani pisar ki choomli hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
Sukoone qalb Laila raahate jaan thay yeh Zainab ke
Sayeed Akbar ko marne ki riza kaise mili hogi
